character: Modern street-style circuit around Hard Rock Stadium with a mix of tight, technical sections and a long back straight. Bumpy surface and limited grip evolution demand a forgiving driving style.

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.technique: Brake hard from the highest speed on the lap, late apex
corners.trap: Locking the front under the heaviest braking zone on the circuit

corners.name: Turn 7-10
corners.technique: Patient, precise inputs — this low-speed section rewards mechanical grip over outright commitment
corners.trap: Over-driving any single corner in this sequence upsets the whole section

corners.name: Turn 13-14
corners.technique: Smooth direction change, use the exit kerb carefully to set up the following straight
corners.trap: Carrying too much speed in and running wide on exit

corners.name: Turn 17
corners.technique: Late apex, clean exit is critical — feeds the main straight
corners.trap: Compromised exit here costs time down the entire straight
